title: How Trak works
intro: Set up your season once. Then Trak helps you with four jobs, every week.
beforeSquad: Check your players. Set their positions and roles.
beforePlan: Objectives for the squad and each player, and how often you evaluate.
weekIntro: Four jobs, in the order a week runs.
schedulingLine: Trainings, matches and events, in Events or with +.
schedulingNote: Families can tell you a player can't make it.
assessingLine: How each player is doing, with a message for them.
assessingDue: Home tells you when an evaluation is due.
assessingObjectives: Objectives are Met or Not yet.
trainingLine: Sessions built from drills, fitted to your numbers.
trainingNote: Drills: search the library, keep favourites in My drills.
matchesLine: Everything before and after a match.
matchesNote: Share the game plan with the team. Publish the result.
goodFamilies: Families see only what you publish or share.
goodHome: Home shows what needs you each day.
goodSettings: Settings: your language and your alerts.
